name: Mazdak mitomycin C trial
question: Does submucosal mitomycin C injection at internal urethrotomy reduce anterior urethral stricture recurrence compared with urethrotomy without mitomycin C?

arms.label: Internal urethrotomy plus submucosal mitomycin C

design.population: Forty men with previously untreated bulbar urethral strictures after straddle injury or other blunt perineal trauma; stricture length ≤1.5 cm on retrograde urethrography.
design.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 1090

verdictNote: Recurrence was lower with mitomycin C; no primary endpoint or sample size was specified.
takeaway: In 40 men with previously untreated trauma-related bulbar strictures, submucosal mitomycin C before urethrotomy reduced recurrence during a mean 15 months of follow-up versus urethrotomy alone (2/20 [10%] versus 10/20 [50%]; p = 0.006).

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Mazdak H, Meshki I, Ghassami F. "Effect of mitomycin C on anterior urethral stricture recurrence after internal urethrotomy." *Eur Urol.* 2007;51(4):1089-1092. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2006.11.038
reports.followUp: Mean 15 months (range 6–24); retrograde urethrography every 6 months or with obstructive symptoms; follow-up data for all 40 men
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Patients and methods and Results, p 1090

results.measure: Men with recurrence during follow-up (mean 15 months, range 6–24); all 40 had follow-up data
results.note: The authors call the comparison statistically significant; no primary endpoint designation or prespecified alpha is reported. No effect estimate or confidence interval is reported.
results.locator: Full text, Results, p 1090 and Table 2, p 1091

delivery.label: Procedure and injection

values.exp: Before incision, 0.1 mg mitomycin C in 2 mL distilled water injected submucosally at 1, 5, 7 and 11 o'clock using a 22-gauge cystoscopic needle; then 12 o'clock cold-knife incision under general anesthesia with a 20F Wolf urethrotome by one surgeon
values.ctl: 12 o'clock cold-knife incision under general anesthesia with a 20F Wolf urethrotome by the same surgeon; no submucosal injection

delivery.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 1090

delivery.label: Postoperative catheter
delivery.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 1090
